meta.title: Enable reloc info for BOLT
meta.body_summary: Enable --emit-relocs -q linker flag on Linux release builds to allow BOLT binary optimizer post-processing of Bun.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex enabled --emit-relocs linker flag for BOLT; CI reported many test timeouts; no human review; PR closed by author without fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 9 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It is a minimal build configuration tweak. The closure is consistent with CI test timeout failures rather than review rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: robobun bot reported extensive test timeouts across multiple Linux platforms for bundler_compile.test.ts and fetch.test.ts, possibly caused by the linker flag change.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable relocation info emission so that BOLT can post-process Bun binary for runtime performance improvements.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after robobun CI reported test timeouts; no verbal rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Enabling a linker flag for BOLT introduces potential binary-level changes that may cause test timeouts; the agent did not anticipate or address CI failures, and the PR was closed without fix.

detection_detail.ci_auto: robobun BuildKite CI reported multiple test timeouts on bundler_compile.test.ts and fetch.test.ts across various Linux environments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or before/after performance data; only the linker flag change without performance validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author closed the PR after 4 days, likely due to CI test failures, without attempting a fix.

core_change_summary.description: In cmake/targets/BuildBun.cmake, added linker flag --emit-relocs -q for Linux release builds to emit relocation information, enabling BOLT binary optimizer post-processing.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Zig format and prettier commits touched unrelated files; not part of the performance change.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added linker flags to BuildBun.cmake.
Subsequent commits: `bun run zig-format` and `bun run prettier` applied formatting to other files.
Final commit: minor update to BuildBun.cmake.
No review; robobun CI reported test timeouts; author closed PR after 4 days.

review_signals.summary: Robobun bot reported 3 failures (multiple test timeouts on bundler_compile.test.ts and fetch.test.ts) across various Linux platforms.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with build flag change.
Immediately robobun bot posted CI failure report with extensive timeouts.
Author pushed a formatting commit and a final minor edit.
